# Keep long header links readable within their layout bound

472 removed nowrap/hidden-overflow/ellipsis from URL anchors. Current .header-message-url a retains display:inline-block and max-inline-size:80vw, allowing wrapping instead of truncating the link. Preserve the distinction between limiting layout and hiding content. No zoom, keyboard, accessibility-tree, or rendered long-URL test was run.

Scope: mail/themes/shared/mail.

## Evidence

[Lesson record](../records/88f1686a9dbb122227f095b0248cf4187198eec1e431c2f5a644c95d4d9751f9.json).

- [Supporting record](../records/41d0ff17567f871b7b812fb16e1e07fd8cde2ce8007a2b615e70c7354063703c.json)

## Validation and limits

Status: **supported**. Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
